content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments is an infrastructure solution specifically designed for creators in areas where traditional payment platforms fail. This model enables the sale of digital goods such as ebooks, courses, and templates without the burden of platform fees that can significantly eat into profits. By using crypto payments instead, creators not only avoid high transaction costs associated with services like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale, but also gain complete ownership over their products and customer data. This sovereignty is essential in empowering creators to maintain control of their financial futures.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store is built on robust, cost-effective tools. At its core, it utilizes platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, ensuring that creators have a reliable, free infrastructure. For backend logic, services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script deliver automation without relying on traditional payment gateways. Order storage can be managed with Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is handled via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The integration with NOWPayments simplifies crypto transactions by automatically verifying payments on-chain at a minimal 0.5% fee, making it a seamless experience for both creators and buyers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is tailored for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where access to conventional payment processors is limited or nonexistent. These creators—who sell products such as digital courses, templates, and music—often face financial isolation due to currency instability and restrictive banking regulations. By adopting a no-KYC payment model, these individuals can directly engage with their audience, sell their products without exorbitant fees, and maintain full ownership of their business operations. This system empowers creators to break free from the constraints imposed by traditional platforms.
Eliminate platform fees by owning your digital sales infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful no-KYC digital product store is a symphony of integrated components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the public-facing website, allowing creators to showcase their products. The backend is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automate processes such as order confirmation and file delivery. Product data is stored securely in Supabase or Google Sheets, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures that digital files are readily available for download. NOWPayments stands as the final piece, offering a diverse range of cryptocurrency options for payment, allowing creators to transact in their preferred currency without the burden of KYC requirements.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Getting started with a no-KYC digital product store involves several clear steps. First, choose your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation. Following this, create a database using Supabase or Google Sheets to store product information. Prepare your digital files for delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. To simplify this process, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to deploy your store efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage a no-KYC payment system that accepts cryptocurrency. This approach eliminates the need for traditional payment processors and associated fees. By using platforms like NOWPayments, you can set up your digital product store quickly while retaining full ownership and control over your sales.
Retain full control over your customer data and product delivery.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

To sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe, set up a digital product store using a no-KYC payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to receive payments in cryptocurrency, eliminating the need for conventional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to use a combination of free hosting solutions and crypto payment processors. This method significantly reduces transaction costs and gives you full control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own digital product store with no-KYC payments. This approach allows for greater flexibility and lower fees.
What are the advantages of using crypto payments?

Using crypto payments provides several advantages, including lower transaction fees, no KYC requirements, and immediate payment verification. This model empowers creators to retain ownership and autonomy over their sales.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, utilize backend automation services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will facilitate instant access to products upon payment confirmation.
